## History

Martin was a hired worker associated with [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Following Matthew's sudden collapse and death, Martin carried out necessary tasks around the farm, including fetching the doctor and a minister, driving to the station, and managing the routine chores during the grieving period.

## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--martin.md)

Martin serves as a hired hand under [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), working on her [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) property. His role involves assisting with the daily agricultural and physical labor required on the farm.
